info.title: AlumniIstü API
info.description: Next-Gen Alumni Intelligence & Career Trajectory Engine for Istanbul University Management Information Systems (YBS). Full CRUD enabled with database persistence, job board, applications pipeline, and in-memory endpoints.

tags.name: Users (Week 03 Milestone)
tags.description: In-memory User CRUD endpoints without database

tags.name: Authentication & CAPTCHA
tags.description: Server-side CAPTCHA challenges, user registration, token-based login, logout revocation, and Bearer authorization

tags.name: RBAC Protected (Admin & Faculty)
tags.description: Role-protected endpoints enforced by AuthMiddleware + RoleMiddleware (401 Unauthorized / 403 Forbidden)

tags.name: User Profile & Dashboard
tags.description: Authenticated user-specific profile editing and activity endpoints with strict ownership authorization

BearerAuth.description: HS256 Bearer access token returned by POST /api/auth/login, POST /api/auth/register, or Google OAuth. Paste the raw JWT token (without the 'Bearer ' prefix) in Swagger UI Authorize.

patch.description: Updates specific fields of the user record (e.g. graduationYear only).

delete.description: Removes the user with the given ID from memory.

get.description: Generates a short-lived, single-use server-side SVG CAPTCHA challenge (alphanumeric or math) that works locally in Docker without external API keys. Also accessible at GET /api/auth/captcha. The plaintext answer is never returned.

data.prompt: Enter the 6 characters shown in the image (case-insensitive)

post.summary: Register New Account with CAPTCHA Verification (alias: /api/auth/register)
post.description: Creates a new AlumniIstü user account (alumni, student, or employer) after validating inputs, verifying the server-side single-use CAPTCHA challenge, checking for duplicate username/email, and hashing the password with password_hash(). Also accessible at POST /api/auth/register. Returns the sanitized user and an HS256 Bearer access token.

201.description: Account registered successfully and Bearer token issued

example.message: An account with email 'zeynep.yilmaz@ogr.iu.edu.tr' already exists.

value.message: Incorrect CAPTCHA answer. Please verify the characters and try again.

errors.captcha: Incorrect CAPTCHA answer. Please verify the characters and try again.

value.message: This CAPTCHA challenge has already been used. Please request a new CAPTCHA.

errors.captcha: This CAPTCHA challenge has already been used. Please request a new CAPTCHA.

value.message: CAPTCHA challenge has expired. Please refresh the CAPTCHA and try again.

errors.captcha: CAPTCHA challenge has expired. Please refresh the CAPTCHA and try again.

post.description: Step (a)-(b) of the Client <-> Server token auth flow: verifies username or email + password against stored password_hash and returns an HS256 Bearer access token containing user identity, role, and unique jti. Also accessible at POST /api/auth/login.

200.description: Authentication succeeded and Bearer token returned

401.description: Invalid credentials (INVALID_CREDENTIALS) or Google-only OAuth account (OAUTH_ACCOUNT_ONLY)

value.message: This account is registered with Google Sign-In. Please continue with Google.

post.description: Revokes the current Bearer JWT server-side (persisting its jti in revoked_tokens) and clears any auth cookie so subsequent requests using the revoked token are rejected with HTTP 401 TOKEN_REVOKED. Also accessible at POST /api/auth/logout.

200.description: Token revoked and session logged out cleanly

example.message: Logged out successfully. Access token has been revoked.

401.description: Missing, invalid, expired, or already-revoked Bearer token

example.message: Access token has been revoked via logout. Please log in again.

get.summary: Get Authenticated User, Role & Dynamic Nav State (alias: /api/auth/me)
get.description: Protected by AuthMiddleware. Validates Authorization: Bearer <token> (or HttpOnly auth cookie) including signature, expiry, revocation, and account active state, returning authenticated=true, role, is_admin, user profile, and RBAC permissions for dynamic frontend navigation.

200.description: Valid token — authenticated user, role, is_admin flag, and RBAC permissions returned

401.description: Missing (TOKEN_MISSING), invalid/expired (TOKEN_INVALID_OR_EXPIRED), or revoked (TOKEN_REVOKED) Bearer token — frontend resets navigation to guest state

403.description: Account deactivated (ACCOUNT_INACTIVE) — frontend resets navigation to guest state

get.description: Returns academic departments used to populate the registration form dropdown.
Returns public configuration metadata indicating local CAPTCHA mode, allowed self-registration roles, and whether Google OAuth 2.0 credentials are active (never exposes secrets).

Generates a signed CSRF state token and redirects the browser to Google's OAuth 2.0 consent screen. Also accessible at GET /api/auth/google. Pass ?format=json or Accept: application/json to receive the authorize_url as JSON.

parameters.name: role
parameters.description: Desired public self-registration role for new users

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Set to 'json' to return the Google authorization URL in JSON instead of HTTP 302 redirect

302.description: Redirects browser to Google OAuth 2.0 authorization URL

200.description: JSON response with authorize_url and signed CSRF state (when ?format=json)

503.description: Google OAuth credentials not configured in .env (GOOGLE_OAUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED)

get.description: Validates the HMAC-signed CSRF state parameter, exchanges the authorization code with Google, verifies email_verified=true, links/creates the user (auth_provider='google', password_hash=NULL), and issues the application HS256 Bearer token.

200.description: Existing or linked Google user authenticated (JSON mode)

201.description: New Google user registered and Bearer token issued (JSON mode)

401.description: Code exchange or Google token verification failed

422.description: Google account email is not verified (GOOGLE_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED)

post.summary: Register / Sign-In via Google ID Token (alias: /api/auth/google/token)
post.description: Verifies a Google OpenID Connect ID token directly against Google tokeninfo (checking aud, iss, exp, email_verified), links or creates the user account, and issues the AlumniIstü HS256 Bearer access token. Also accessible at POST /api/auth/google/token.

200.description: Existing or email-linked Google user authenticated

201.description: New user registered via Google OAuth (auth_provider='google', password_hash=NULL)

401.description: Invalid, expired, or audience-mismatched Google ID token (GOOGLE_TOKEN_INVALID)

422.description: Missing id_token, disallowed role, or unverified Google email (GOOGLE_EMAIL_UNVERIFIED)

patch.summary: Activate or Deactivate User Account (Protected: admin only)
patch.description: Sets users.is_active to true or false. Blocks self-deactivation with 422 CANNOT_DEACTIVATE_SELF. Also accessible at PATCH /api/admin/users/{id}/status.

delete.description: Permanently deletes a user account. Blocks self-deletion with 422 CANNOT_DELETE_SELF. Also accessible at DELETE /api/admin/users/{id}.

get.description: Protected by AuthMiddleware. Returns the logged-in user's full editable profile (graduation info, bio, contact links, skills) and linked alumni directory record.

401.description: Unauthorized — missing, invalid, or revoked Bearer token

patch.description: Protected by AuthMiddleware. Allows a user to update only their own profile (full_name, graduation_year, department_id, company, job_title, location, bio, skills, linkedin_url, github_url, website_url, phone). Attempting to modify restricted fields like role or is_active returns 403 FORBIDDEN_FIELD_MUTATION.

bio.example: MIS graduate mentoring students in cloud & data engineering.

403.description: Forbidden — attempted to mutate restricted fields (FORBIDDEN_FIELD_MUTATION)

422.description: Validation error (invalid URL, graduation year out of range, bio > 1000 chars)

patch.description: Regular users can only update their own user ID (returns 403 OWNERSHIP_VIOLATION for any other user ID). Admins may update any user's profile.
